title: Mandatory KYC controls not requested by stakeholders
description: 2 mandatory controls were absent from stakeholder input and were derived from the control catalogue: KYC-C04, KYC-C19.
mitigation: Compliance officer validates derived requirements before baseline; include them in sprint 0 scope.

title: Stakeholder contradiction (OPS-KYC-001, REG-KYC-002)
description: Opposing positions on manual review: OPS-KYC-001 (Priya (Product Owner)) vs REG-KYC-002 (Arjun (Chief Compliance Officer)).
mitigation: Facilitated decision by product owner; record the resolution in the conflict log.

title: Stakeholder contradiction (OPS-KYC-001, SR-KYC-003)
description: Opposing positions on control KYC-C17 (Human review of automated adverse decisions): OPS-KYC-001 (Priya (Product Owner)) vs SR-KYC-003 (Customer research panel).
mitigation: Facilitated decision by product owner; record the resolution in the conflict log.

title: Stakeholder contradiction (DAT-KYC-001, DAT-KYC-003)

title: Regulatory conflict: KYC-C10
description: DAT-KYC-001: Retention of 3 years is below the 5-year post-relationship minimum (FATF R.11 / PMLA / AMLD).
mitigation: Legal/compliance interpretation and requirement rewrite before baseline.

title: Threat T-DOC-UPLOAD
description: Tampering / Elevation: Malicious file uploaded as an identity document.
mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

title: Threat T-BIO-PRIV

mitigation: Implement linked security requirements; verify with threat-model review, SAST/DAST and penetration test.

title: Threat T-API

title: Legacy core-banking integration
description: Account creation depends on legacy core banking interfaces (batch windows, limited APIs) that may break real-time onboarding targets.
mitigation: Spike in sprint 1; asynchronous account creation with status callbacks; contract tests against a CBS simulator.

title: Verification-vendor dependency
description: Outage or degradation of identity, screening or registry vendors stops onboarding.
mitigation: Dual-vendor strategy or graceful queueing; vendor SLAs and exit plan; circuit breakers.

title: Biometric data breach
description: Compromise of face images or templates is irreversible for customers.
mitigation: Template protection, encryption with HSM keys, minimal retention, DPIA.

title: Ambiguous or untestable requirements
description: 10 requirements are vague or incomplete, which risks scope creep and failed UAT.
mitigation: Resolve the clarification questions before the baseline gate.

title: Automated adverse decisions without human review
description: Fully automated rejection may breach automated-decision rules and fairness expectations.
mitigation: Human review for rejections; reason codes; contest channel.
